question: Among the top 5 drivers by total points in the 2017 season, identify who achieved the fastest lap time across all their races. Provide their full name, nationality, and the race name where this fastest lap occurred.

    SELECT
        ds.XCL_029 AS driver_id,
        SUM(ds.XCL_030) AS total_points
    FROM driverStandings AS ds
    INNER JOIN races AS r ON ds.XCL_028 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2017
    GROUP BY ds.XCL_029
    ORDER BY total_points DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT
        lt.XCL_044 AS driver_id,
        lt.XCL_043 AS race_id,
        lt.XCL_048 AS lap_time_ms,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lt.XCL_044 ORDER BY lt.XCL_048 ASC) AS rn
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    INNER JOIN races AS r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
    INNER JOIN top5_drivers AS t5 ON lt.XCL_044 = t5.driver_id
    WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2017
      AND lt.XCL_048 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname,
    d.XCL_041 AS nationality,
    r.XCL_069 AS race_name
FROM top5_drivers AS t5
INNER JOIN fastest_laps AS fl ON t5.driver_id = fl.driver_id AND fl.rn = 1
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON t5.driver_id = d.XCL_034
INNER JOIN races AS r ON fl.race_id = r.XCL_065
ORDER BY t5.total_points DESC
